python.imports:
import fluentqt
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QHBoxLayout, QVBoxLayout, QWidget
python.setup:
control = fluentqt.Window(%PARENT%)
control.setWindowTitle("Fluent Window")
title_content = QWidget(control.titleBar())
title_layout = QHBoxLayout(title_content)
title_layout.setContentsMargins(10, 0, 8, 0)
title_layout.setSpacing(8)
app_icon = fluentqt.FontIcon(fluentqt.Typography.Icons.Home, title_content)
app_icon.setIconSize(14)
title_layout.addWidget(app_icon)
app_name = fluentqt.Label("Fluent Window", title_content)
app_name.setFluentTypography(fluentqt.FontRole.BodyStrong)
title_layout.addWidget(app_name)
shell_tag = fluentqt.Label("App shell", title_content)
shell_tag.setFluentTypography(fluentqt.FontRole.Caption)
shell_tag.setTextColorRole(fluentqt.Label.TextColorRole.Secondary)
title_layout.addWidget(shell_tag)
title_layout.addStretch(1)
control.titleBar().setContentWidget(title_content)
body = QWidget(control)
body_layout = QVBoxLayout(body)
body_layout.setContentsMargins(20, 14, 20, 18)
body_layout.setSpacing(12)
heading = fluentqt.Label("Desktop workspace", body)
heading.setFluentTypography(fluentqt.FontRole.Subtitle)
body_layout.addWidget(heading)
card = fluentqt.Card(body)
card.setAppearance(fluentqt.Card.Appearance.LayerAlt)
card_layout = QVBoxLayout(card)
card_layout.setContentsMargins(16, 12, 16, 14)
card_layout.setSpacing(8)
card_title = fluentqt.Label("Backdrop & window chrome", card)
card_title.setFluentTypography(fluentqt.FontRole.BodyStrong)
card_layout.addWidget(card_title)
card_desc = fluentqt.Label("Switch Backdrop effect below to compare Solid, Mica, and Acrylic surfaces.", card)
card_desc.setFluentTypography(fluentqt.FontRole.Caption)
card_desc.setTextColorRole(fluentqt.Label.TextColorRole.Secondary)
card_desc.setWordWrap(True)
card_layout.addWidget(card_desc)
actions = QHBoxLayout()
actions.setSpacing(8)
primary = fluentqt.Button("New project", card)
primary.setFluentStyle(fluentqt.Button.ButtonStyle.Accent)
primary.setFluentSize(fluentqt.Button.ButtonSize.Small)
secondary = fluentqt.Button("Settings", card)
secondary.setFluentSize(fluentqt.Button.ButtonSize.Small)
actions.addWidget(primary)
actions.addWidget(secondary)
actions.addStretch(1)
card_layout.addLayout(actions)
body_layout.addWidget(card)
body_layout.addStretch(1)
control.setContentWidget(body)
